data.name: ab_story_p1
data.value: With its small 14-room structure, Sunmed Lodge offers a more personal and comfortable experience away from the crowds of large hotels. We care that our guests feel settled, rest in clean and tidy rooms, and slow down the pace of the day in the garden.

data.name: ab_story_p2
data.value: You can start the day calmly with a free breakfast, take short breaks at the café area during the day, and easily reach Ölüdeniz and the Fethiye area. Cleanliness, sincerity, and simple comfort are at the heart of the Sunmed Lodge experience.
